meta.name: deepchem
meta.description: Molecular ML with diverse featurizers and pre-built datasets. Use for property prediction (ADMET, toxicity) with traditional ML or GNNs when you want extensive featurization options and MoleculeNet benchmarks. Best for quick experiments with pre-trained models, diverse molecular representations. For graph-first PyTorch workflows use torchdrug; for benchmark datasets use pytdc.

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude uses DeepChem to load molecular data (SMILES/SDF/FASTA), featurize molecules (fingerprints, descriptors, graphs), train classical or graph neural models for property prediction (solubility, toxicity, ADMET), and run MoleculeNet benchmarks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to predict molecular properties (toxicity, solubility, ADMET), use MoleculeNet benchmarks, or process molecular data in SMILES/SDF/FASTA formats.
